The '''Chorlian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Companion" /> that was considered to be part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] for much of its history. Known for its near-lawlessness,<ref name="Zygerrian">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030724takedown|text=Zygerrian Takedown|int=Zygerrian Takedown}}</ref> the sector contained more than half a dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], including the [[Malachor system/Legends|Malachor system]]<ref name="Companion" />&mdash;the site of a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Malachor V rebellion|rebellion]] under the reign of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]],<ref name="Rebelling Slaves" /> the [[Battle of Malachor V]] that decided the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="KOTOR 2" />&mdash;as well as the [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria system]], home of the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and the [[Rekkiad system/Legends|Rekkiad]] and [[Nathema system/Legends|Nathema systems]].<ref name="Companion" /> The sector was under the control of various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] states for much of history, with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema|Medriaas]] serving as an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] for the first [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Revan" /> and [[Malachor V]] was the site of the [[Trayus Academy]] before the planet's [[Battle of Malachor|destruction]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]].<ref name="KOTOR 2" /> The Chorlian sector was crossed by the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes, and was located on the edges of the known galaxy.<ref name="Companion" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the sector was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by a [[Unidentified Chorlian sector senator|senator]] who believed that the Senate had been infiltrated by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents.<ref name="Specter" />
